description: Science Data Bank identifies HSPEI, a gridded Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index for mainland China at 1 km resolution. The provider's current page title states 2001–2022, while the inspected DataCite description says 2001–2020; the exact years present in files remain unverified. The metadata lists one-, three-, six-, twelve- and twenty-four-month drought windows and CC BY 4.0. The authors combine station calculations with satellite precipitation and land-surface temperature, ERA5-Land radiation, elevation and random-forest interpolation. These grids can provide drought-hazard forcing for irrigation, water-supply and agricultural resilience simulations. SPEI is a standardized climate index, not observed reservoir storage or a forecast of service failure. Spatial validation and the year discrepancy should be checked before aligning it with asset records. It complements data-spei-hr-global-high-resolution-drought-indices, a separate coarser global product. No grid file was downloaded.
